notes: Country determination: Germany, certainty high (plan title block 'Lausicker Str. 26, 04299 Leipzig', German-language drawings by luka architekten Leipzig, EU license plate 'L KD 3455' = Leipzig, EN 840 wheelie bins, green wooden fence). Calc profile DE.
All 8 PDF pages are ONE plan set (luka architekten, 11.06.2012, scale 1:100, Entwurfsplanung 'Sanierung EFH'). No rotated scans detected.
Red line work on the plans marks PLANNED refurbishment elements; black is the existing building. Photos show the as-built state and win on existence per conflict rule.

Elevation mapping: front = street side = 'Ansicht von Nordosten' (entry door, garage right); back = 'Ansicht von Südwesten' (garden, veranda/terrace); left = 'Ansicht von Südosten'; right = 'Ansicht von Nordwesten' (attached garage).
Building is a ~1920s/30s villa: stucco with dark clinker brick base and quoin bands; clinker coursing treated as Reichsformat-like ~78 mm incl. joint (format not stated - market-typical at best).
Section levels (page 1): Keller -1.15½, EG +0.94, OG +4.36½, Traufe +7.29/+7.34½, First +12.22½ - used for all height fields.
Photos 6 and 9: facade corners lie close to the frame edges; mild wide-angle compression possible on width chains from these photos.
Roof covering appears as small-format flat dark-grey elements; classified as slate but flat dark tile cannot be fully excluded (see warnings).

warnings: Plan vs. photo: roof windows/solar panels are drawn RED (planned) on the 2012 plans; photos show 2 rooflights (SK-1/SK-2) and 3 back dormer windows as-built - photo wins on existence, elements included.
Plan vs. photo: OG windows on SO and NW elevations drawn red (planned alterations); photos 1/7 confirm windows exist as-built - included with plan-scaled sizes.
openings likely undercounted on back - base zone occluded by dense vegetation (photo occlusion up to 35%); basement windows on the back not verifiable.
openings likely undercounted on right - attached garage and firewood store occlude the EG/basement zone of the NW wall.
Garage depth (AT-2, RF-5, E-15) carries no written chain; derived graphically via the 1:100 sheet scale - confidence low.
Two openings covered by fabric sheets (W-16 veranda side glazing, W-30 center dormer window); their dimensions are estimated behind the covering - confidence low.

Sloped site: front grade +0,08, back grade -1,13 (plan levels). Single eave/ridge heights are referenced to the lowest grade; heights.per_elevation filled - photo-based height estimates reference different local grades.

Entry door D-1 height implied by plan proportions/photos ~2200 mm exceeds the DE table value 1985/2110 mm - consistent with a pre-1950 building; door-based scale chains treated as statistical per catalog rule.
Roof covering ambiguous: small-format flat dark-grey elements read as slate, but a flat dark tile cannot be excluded from the photos - material 'slate' set with reservation.
Wall gross areas of WL-2/WL-3/WL-4 include zones covered by the attached veranda block and garage (interior overlap); net areas subtract openings only.
Width chains: vehicle-based 12800 mm vs plate-based 13150 mm vs plan 12940 mm agree within ~3%; written plan dimension governs.
Opening positions (position_mm) are partly estimated from photos (source estimated); the plan elevations are not dimensioned per opening axis.
Sidelight windows W-2/W-3 flanking the entry are inferred from the EG dimension chain (47½ values) and partially visible in photo 9 - heights low confidence.
